title: [Culture Crunch] Workie Talkie  with Fashion Designer Yang Yoon-a 패션 디자이너 양윤아
description:
💼Workie Talkie💼

The topic of this month's "Workie Talkie" is "K-fashion"

We joined fashion designer Yang Yoon-a, who protects animal rights and the environment with her sustainable vegan design!
As an alternative material developed by herself, they are proposing sensuous vegan fashion that even celebrities look for as everyday clothes!!!

Q. If you were to turn your life into a drama, what title would you give it to?
A. Outfit Surgery?!, Fashion Designer was
to get plastic surgery with clothes with brand identity~

지속 가능한 비건 디자인으로 동물권과 환경을 보호하는
패션 디자이너 양윤아 님과 함께 했습니다!
직접 개발하신 대체 소재로 셀럽들도 찾는
감각적인 비건 패션을 일상복으로 제안하고 있어요~!!!

Q. 만약 패션 디자이너 님의 삶을 드라마로 만든다면 어떤 제목을 붙이고 싶으신가요?
A. Outfit Sergery?!, 패션 디자이너라는 직업이 브랜드 아이덴티티를 담은
옷으로 성형수술 해주는 것 같다는 생각을 했어요~
